title: Prime Minister shares an article by Lok Sabha Speaker Shri Om Birla highlighting the role of the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum in strengthening parliamentary dialogue and cooperation
body_text:
The Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi has shared an article written by the Lok Sabha Speaker, Shri Om Birla. In the article, Shri Om Birla writes about the role of the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum in strengthening parliamentary dialogue and cooperation among member and partner countries. It highlights that the forum will discuss institutional resilience, AI governance, South-South cooperation and sustainability, guided by the four pillars of India’s 2026 BRICS Chairship. The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X: “Hon'ble @loksabhaspeaker Shri @ombirlakota writes about the role of the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum in strengthening parliamentary dialogue and cooperation among member and partner countries. The forum will discuss institutional resilience, AI governance, South-South cooperation and sustainability, guided by the four pillars of India’s 2026 BRICS Chairship.” Hon'ble @loksabhaspeaker Shri @ombirlakota writes about the role of the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum in strengthening parliamentary dialogue and cooperation among member and partner countries.

The forum will discuss institutional resilience, AI governance, South-South cooperation and sustainability, guided by the four pillars of India’s 2026 BRICS Chairship. — PMO India (@PMOIndia) October 26, 2026 **** MJPS/SS/PRK
